# UI audit — Bayonne team store (before)

**Branch at audit:** `cursor/ui-audit-motion-8bc8` @ Phase 0 commit  
**Scope:** `/team`, `/team/bayonne-bees`, PDP, `/preorder`  
**References:** `knowledge/competitors/ui-patterns.md`  
**Do not edit this file after commit** — it is the before-state.

Scoring: **0** absent · **1** present but broken/misleading · **2** usable with gaps · **3** solid.

## A. Information architecture

### 1. Department routing — real pages vs anchors · **0** · `MISSING`
Departments are client state + hash on a single PLP (`team.$slug.index.tsx` L44–56, L149–168). No `/team/bayonne-bees/match` route, no per-department metadata. Competitors (adidas Men/Women; Represent collections) use real destinations.

### 2. URL design · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
PDP URLs are shareable (`/team/bayonne-bees/jersey`). Department deep-links are fragile hashes (`#sideline`) with no OG/title per department. Gallery mode, font, name, size are **React state only** — not in URL (`team.$slug.$product.tsx` L76–84).

### 3. Depth to purchase · **2** · `OK` (with MTO caveat)
Landing → store → PDP → sticky CTA → Shopify `/cart/add` → checkout. Typically **3–4 clicks** before leave-to-Shopify. Acceptable for made-to-order; do not compress to adidas-style one-tap.

### 4. Navigation persistence on long scroll · **0** · `MISSING`
Headers are in-flow (`team.index.tsx` L55; `team.$slug.index.tsx` L66; PDP L278). No sticky/fixed chrome. Only PDP sticky purchase bar (`team.$slug.$product.tsx` L589–607).

### 5. Back-path from product → department · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
PDP back link goes to `/team/$slug` without `hash` (`team.$slug.$product.tsx` L279–285). User loses Match vs Alumni context.

### 6. Variant handling — URL vs hidden state · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Size / font / name / number / gallery mode live in component state. Refresh loses personalization draft. Shopify variant id is computed, not reflected in URL.

**IA subtotal: 5 / 18**

## B. Interaction mechanics

### 7. Product card hover — second view · **0** · `MISSING`
Cards scale only (`team.$slug.index.tsx` L210–214). No secondary plate swap. Touch has no alternate affordance. (adidas/Represent also skipped second-view on observed grids — optional, but our plates have front+side/back pairs unused on cards.)

### 8. Size selection · **2** · `DEFICIENT`
Grid with selected styles; disabled = “still syncing” not true OOS (`L475–498`). Size guide present. No explicit out-of-stock copy; no error if user never picks size beyond CTA step label.

### 9. Cart pattern · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
No drawer/page. Hidden form POST to Shopify (`L562–583`) with `return_to=/checkout`. Context leaves the site immediately — expected for MTO checkout, but empty/error cart UX is entirely Shopify’s.

### 10. Gallery · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Text view buttons + `ProductCanvas` (`L301–317`). No zoom, no image thumbnails, no keyboard arrows, no swipe (`embla-carousel-react` unused).

### 11. Name-and-number input feedback · **2** · `DEFICIENT` (signature — see below)
Live `onChange` → canvas (`OutlinedField` L647; sanitize L391). Visible counters (`counter` L382–392). Auto flip to back in name-it mode (L118–121). Gaps: diacritics stripped (`sanitizeName` `/[^A-Z \-']/`); no size→print-scale coupling; no distinct “committed” moment beyond confirm checkbox.

### 12. Empty / loading / error · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Root 404/error (`__root.tsx`). Sync banners on store/PDP. **No** empty-category message, **no** skeletons. Errors soft (“still syncing”) rather than actionable failure states.

### 13. Sticky purchase affordance · **3** · `OK`
Fixed bottom CTA with step labels (`L589–607`). `pb-28` on main clears it.

### 14. Touch targets and thumb reach · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Primary CTA / size cells ~adequate (`py-3.5`/`py-4`). Category tabs and filter checkbox `size-3.5` (`team.$slug.index.tsx` L179) under 44px. Focus rings inconsistent on custom buttons (fields have `focus-within:ring-1`).

**Interaction subtotal: 11 / 24**

## C. Motion

### 15. Page-load sequence · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Landing has rise / logo-in / bar-in / kenburns (`styles.css` L232–433; `team.index.tsx`). Durations ad-hoc (700ms–1100ms–28s). No shared token system. PDP liquid backdrop drifts continuously.

### 16. Scroll reveals · **0** · `MISSING`
No IntersectionObserver reveals. (Good: nothing replays — but also nothing intentional.)

### 17. Department → product transition · **0** · `MISSING`
Full navigation; no View Transitions API.

### 18. Hover micro-interactions · **1** · `DEFICIENT`
Opacity/scale with mixed `duration-[1.1s]` and default transitions. No `--dur-micro` tokens.

### 19. Countdown · **2** · `DEFICIENT`
Landing ticks every 60s (`StoreCloseCountdown.tsx` L24). Store header is static days string (`team.$slug.index.tsx` L46–77).

### 20. Video · **0** · `MISSING`
No `<video>` in app. (Aligns with MTO quietness; Represent’s VIP autoplay is optional later.)

### 21. `prefers-reduced-motion` · **2** · `DEFICIENT`
Global hammer to `0.01ms` (`styles.css` L435–445). Many `motion-safe:` wrappers. Landing lookbook hover scale at `team.index.tsx` L204 is **not** `motion-safe`-gated. Spec wants opacity &lt;100ms kept for feedback — current approach nukes transitions entirely (acceptable functionally, coarse).

### 22. Layout stability · **2** · `DEFICIENT`
Most product frames use `aspect-*` boxes. Full-bleed heroes often lack intrinsic width/height. No measured CLS in CI.

**Motion subtotal: 8 / 24**

## Tier mapping (implementation plan)

### Tier 1 (implement on this branch after this commit)
- Motion tokens in CSS; remap / delete non-mapping animation
- Tighten reduced-motion (keep functional opacity feedback ≤100ms)
- Focus-visible on interactive controls; 44px min targets
- Aspect reservation hygiene on remaining heroes
- Store countdown live tick (reuse component)
- Product card second-view on hover; touch: swap indicator / tap cycle — not dead
- Empty category state; clearer sync/error copy (no apology, actionable)
- Sticky CTA already OK — verify thumb reach
- Signature: diacritics (NFD strip or allow Latin-1 letters), measure latency, stronger commit feedback; size→lettering scale if feasible without Tier 2

### Tier 2 (separate unmerged branches)
- Department routes `/team/bayonne-bees/{match|sideline|warmups|alumni}` + hash redirects
- Cart drawer only if audit escalation justified (Shopify leave may stay — note conflict with MTO)
- Gallery zoom/keyboard/swipe
- View Transitions department→product

### Tier 3 (report only)
- Prices/copy (other prompts)
- Queen Bees chapter
- Third-party apps
- Any adidas visual language / three-stripe

---

## Conflicts with reference patterns (do not adopt blindly)

Neither adidas nor Represent sells made-to-order named kit with a close window. Instant cart gratification and Reels-weight hero video are **wrong defaults** here. Prefer quiet chrome; spend boldness on the name preview.
